messages:
alice-partnerships: Heads-up: cross-checking launch windows for the marketplace listing, partner co-announcement, and our email drip. want everything synchronized but with a fail-safe path. timeline suggestion: partner preview Tue, embargo Wed evening, publish Thu 08:00 PT.
riley-marketing: agree on timeline. i'll draft the co-marketing email + social frames. need UTMs for partner links and preferred call-to-action. sending template in a bit.
zane-legal: two items: (1) partner NDAs need a final clause for joint quotes, (2) marketing asset approval SLA is 48h. if you need exceptions, loop me in early.
arya-design: will deliver co-branded hero + two screenshot variants (desktop/mobile). can we confirm exact logo clearspace and background requirements?
tom-eng: integration note: SI partners require a quickstart that shows a terraform snippet and a marketplace SKU. i'll add a small tutorial and a 1-click deployment button; need final image tag and sku mapping by Wed 10:00 PT.
vishal-ops: ops checklist: staging deployment, smoke tests, canary 30m with 5% traffic, rollback job. also need billing test account for marketplace purchase flow. tagging deploy-bot.
partner-bot: Reminder: please attach partner assets to this thread or upload to https://drive.redwood.example/partners/launch_1975 by 1975011000.
alice-partnerships: Also coordinate with hardware partner (NimbleChip) on co-marketing. they want a product brief + benchmark numbers on the landing page. do we have an embargo for third-party benchmarks?
riley-marketing: If partners provide benchmark screenshots, we need methodology blurb and raw data link. i'll add a short methodology section on the microsite.
zane-legal: benchmarks must have a short disclaimer and measurement methodology. send to legal for review by Tue EOD.
tom-eng: For the terraform snippet, i propose this minimal example. please check before we publish:
```hcl
module "redwood_marketplace" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/inference/marketplace"
  version = "v1.0.0"
  image = "redwood/inference:REPLACE_ME"
}
```
arya-design: noted on hero variants. can marketing confirm headline and subhead? those determine layout.
riley-marketing: Draft headline: "Redwood Marketplace: One-click LLM deployments with partner integrations". subhead options coming soon.
vishal-ops: QA/ops question: do we want telemetry tags for partner traffic? we should add utm_partner param and a partner_id header for easier rollups in the console.
alice-partnerships: Good call. add partner_id header and utm rules. marketing: include those in email links.
partner-bot: Deployment scheduled: staging-microsite at 1975012600 by tom-eng.
zane-legal: final reminder: all partner quotes need signed approval (even via Slack) before PR embargo lift.
riley-marketing: I'll circulate the press list and ask partners to confirm reporter embargo notifications.
tom-eng: Note: marketplace SKU schema below. we need mapping to billing product codes before publish.
```
SKU: RW-MP-001
Name: Redwood Marketplace - Base
BillingCode: BILL_RW_MP_BASE
```
alice-partnerships: If anything slips, fallback plan is feature flag marketplace_rollout_mode=partner-by-partner. can we get flags created by eng-infra?
vishal-ops: I'll create the flags and add a canary window. aim to have flags by Wed 18:00 PT.
arya-design: final ask: give me final partner logos + co-brand copy by Tue 12:00 so we can run accessibility checks.
alice-partnerships: next check-in Tue 14:00 PT. drop blockers here. thanks everyone. :rocket:
